run_model_pose_predictions: run the TestPoseSL model on a dataloader to generate pose predictions and save outputs
get_accuracy_pose_labels: get the accuracy score by comparing ground truth and predicted pose labels for tx, ty, yaw
get_overall_metrics_pose: get overall metrics including top-k accuracy, balanced accuracy, and confidence intervals for pose classification
